Architecture ID: ARCH-001

Title: Inference Platform

Business Requirements

The AetherAI Cloud Inference Platform provides scalable, secure, reliable, and cost-efficient AI inference capabilities for enterprise customers. The platform serves as the foundation for delivering large language model responses, retrieval-augmented generation workflows, agent execution tasks, evaluation operations, classification services, summarization workloads, and other AI-powered business capabilities.

The platform must satisfy the following business requirements:

• Support enterprise-scale AI workloads
• Deliver low-latency responses
• Support multi-tenant environments
• Provide high availability
• Maintain security and compliance standards
• Enable rapid model deployment
• Support cost governance
• Integrate with retrieval systems
• Provide observability and monitoring
• Support disaster recovery requirements

The architecture must support both internal platform services and customer-facing applications.

Architecture Overview

The Inference Platform is deployed within AWS and follows a microservices-based architecture built around scalable inference gateways, orchestration services, model routing components, monitoring systems, and security controls.

Data Flow

Step 1

Step 2

The Application Load Balancer forwards traffic to the Inference Gateway.

Step 3

Authentication and authorization controls validate the request.

Step 4

The Model Router selects the appropriate inference provider.

Step 5

Step 6

The provider returns the generated response.

Step 7

Validation controls inspect the output.

Step 8

Usage analytics and audit events are recorded.

Step 9

The response is returned to the requesting client.

Architecture ID: ARCH-002

Title: RAG Platform

Business Requirements

The Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Platform serves as the knowledge retrieval foundation for AetherAI Cloud's AI ecosystem. The platform enables large language models to access enterprise knowledge, operational documentation, architecture records, security policies, incident reports, runbooks, product documentation, and customer-specific information at inference time.

The primary business objective is to improve response quality, reduce hallucinations, increase factual accuracy, support enterprise knowledge management, and provide explainable AI responses grounded in authoritative information sources.

The platform must satisfy the following requirements:

The platform must satisfy the following requirements:

• Enterprise-grade knowledge retrieval
• Low-latency search performance
• High retrieval accuracy
• Support for millions of documents
• Multi-tenant isolation
• Scalable ingestion pipelines
• Continuous knowledge updates
• Security and compliance controls
• Evaluation and quality monitoring
• Cost-efficient operation

The platform supports internal services, enterprise customers, AI agents, evaluation systems, and operational workflows.

Architecture Overview

Architecture ID: ARCH-003

Title: Multi Region Strategy

Business Requirements

The Multi Region Strategy defines the architectural approach for ensuring business continuity, high availability, disaster resilience, geographic redundancy, and operational continuity across the AetherAI Cloud platform. As enterprise customers increasingly depend on AI-driven services for mission-critical workloads, the platform must remain resilient against regional infrastructure failures, cloud service disruptions, network outages, and large-scale operational incidents.

The architecture must satisfy the following business requirements:

• Regional failure tolerance
• High service availability
• Disaster recovery readiness
• Regulatory compliance support
• Reduced operational risk
• Global customer support
• Data durability
• Business continuity assurance
• Scalable growth across regions
• Low recovery times

The strategy applies to all core services including the Enterprise RAG Platform, LLM Gateway, Evaluation Engine, Reliability Platform, Knowledge Hub, Agent Workflow Studio, and supporting infrastructure components.

Architecture Overview

The AetherAI Cloud platform adopts a multi-region deployment model using AWS infrastructure. Production workloads are distributed across a Primary Region and one or more Secondary Regions capable of supporting failover operations.

The architecture follows a regional redundancy model that provides:

• Active-Active services where required
• Active-Passive services where operationally appropriate
• Cross-region replication
• Automated backup strategies
• Disaster recovery orchestration

Regional deployments are designed to operate independently while maintaining synchronization of critical data and configurations.

Title: Production Deployment Process

Purpose

This Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) defines the mandatory process for deploying application, infrastructure, machine learning, and AI platform changes into the AetherAI Cloud production environment. The objective is to ensure safe, repeatable, auditable, and low-risk deployments while maintaining platform availability and compliance requirements. This procedure applies to all services supporting the Enterprise RAG Platform, LLM Gateway, AI Reliability Platform, Evaluation Engine, Agent Workflow Studio, and supporting AWS infrastructure.

Scope

This procedure applies to:

• Backend services deployed to Amazon EKS
• FastAPI microservices
• AI Gateway components
• LangGraph orchestration services
• Vector database services
• Data processing pipelines
• Infrastructure managed through Terraform
• CI/CD workflows executed through GitHub Actions
• Monitoring and observability integrations

This SOP is mandatory for engineering, platform, MLOps, DevOps, and reliability teams.

Prerequisites

Before initiating a production deployment, the following requirements must be satisfied:

1. All code changes must be merged into the protected main branch.
2. Pull request approval must be completed by at least two reviewers.
3. Automated unit tests must achieve a minimum pass rate of 95 percent.
4. Integration test execution must complete successfully.
5. Security scanning must report no Critical or High vulnerabilities.
6. Container images must be stored within Amazon ECR.
7. Infrastructure changes must have approved Terraform plans.
8. Release notes must be documented.
9. Monitoring dashboards must be validated.
10. Rollback procedures must be reviewed.

Technical Details

Technical Details

The AetherAI production environment is hosted within AWS and consists of multiple Amazon EKS clusters deployed across multiple Availability Zones. Deployments are executed through GitHub Actions pipelines integrated with AWS Identity and Access Management roles.

Primary deployment components include:

• Amazon EKS
• Amazon ECR
• AWS Load Balancer Controller
• Amazon RDS PostgreSQL
• Amazon OpenSearch
• Amazon S3
• AWS Secrets Manager
• AWS CloudWatch
• AWS X-Ray
• GitHub Actions

Deployment artifacts are packaged as immutable Docker images. Each image receives a unique version tag linked to the associated Git commit SHA. Direct deployments from local workstations are prohibited.

Step-by-Step Procedure

Step 1: Release Validation

The release engineer reviews the deployment request and verifies completion of all prerequisite activities. Release documentation, test evidence, security reports, and infrastructure plans must be attached to the release ticket.

v2.4.1

Step 4: Deployment Approval

The deployment request enters the release approval workflow. Required approvers include:

• Engineering Manager
• Platform Operations Lead
• Security Representative

Approval records are retained for audit purposes.

Step 5: Production Deployment Initiation

Upon approval, the deployment workflow is triggered from GitHub Actions.

If deployment validation fails, the following actions must occur immediately:

1. Halt further rollout activities.
2. Notify Platform Operations.
3. Initiate rollback procedures.

6. Preserve deployment artifacts for investigation.

• Service availability below 99 percent

• Critical business workflow failures

Rollback execution must restore the previously verified production version.

Prerequisites

Rollback Triggers

Immediate rollback consideration is required when one or more of the following conditions occur:

• Error rate exceeds 5 percent

• Database migration failures occur

Step 1: Incident Declaration

Step 2: Deployment Freeze

• Disable automated releases
• Pause deployment pipelines

Step 3: Incident Assessment

Step 5: Execute Application Rollback

Cryptographic keys are critical security assets that protect sensitive data, authenticate services, secure communications, and support encryption mechanisms across production systems.

Regular key rotation reduces the risk associated with long-term key exposure, credential compromise, unauthorized access, insider threats, and cryptographic attacks. This procedure ensures that encryption controls remain effective while maintaining operational stability and compliance with organizational security requirements.

This procedure supports all AetherAI Cloud services including the Enterprise RAG Platform, LLM Gateway, Guardrails Gateway, Evaluation Engine, Knowledge Hub, Agent Workflow Studio, Reliability Platform, and supporting AWS infrastructure.

Title: Incident Response Standard

The purpose of this Incident Response Standard is to establish a structured, repeatable, and auditable process for identifying, analyzing, containing, eradicating, recovering from, and documenting security incidents affecting the AetherAI Cloud environment. As AetherAI Cloud operates critical AI infrastructure supporting the Enterprise RAG Platform, LLM Gateway, Guardrails Gateway, Evaluation Engine, Knowledge Hub, Agent Workflow Studio, and Reliability Platform, rapid and effective incident response is essential to maintaining service availability, customer trust, regulatory compliance, and operational resilience.

Title: Secure Development Lifecycle

Objective

The purpose of this Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) Standard is to establish mandatory security requirements that are integrated throughout the software development lifecycle for all applications, services, infrastructure components, AI systems, and automation workflows developed and operated by AetherAI Cloud. The objective is to proactively identify, prevent, and mitigate security risks before software reaches production environments.

By embedding security controls into planning, design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance activities, AetherAI Cloud reduces vulnerabilities, improves software quality, strengthens operational resilience, and protects customer information. This standard supports secure delivery of the Enterprise RAG Platform, LLM Gateway, Guardrails Gateway, Evaluation Engine, Knowledge Hub, Agent Workflow Studio, Reliability Platform, and all supporting cloud infrastructure.
